turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.

Comanda SC-2074 a fost deja expediată, deci adresa nu se mai poate schimba automat. Am predat cazul unui coleg, care va decide și va prelua conversația. Vă rugăm să pregătiți noua adresă completă.

Order SC-2074 has already shipped, so the address can't be changed automatically. I've passed your case to a colleague, who will decide and take over. Please have the full new address ready.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer (nell.ashcombe@example.com) asks to change the delivery address for SC-2074. Order already shipped, so policy does not allow an automatic change; staff must decide. New address not yet given.
